exposure.needed: whether any scripts or tooling list Kubernetes events using a regardingObject field-selector that targets the Pod

consequence.statement: Event listings that filter by a regardingObject field-selector pointing at the Pod will no longer return the Pod-restart events until the selector is updated to specify the Kafka resource instead.
consequence.remediation: Update any event-listing field-selector that uses regardingObject to target the Pod so that it specifies the Kafka resource instead.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events for Pod restarts no longer have the Pod as the regardingObject, so anyone using regardingObject as a field-selector for listing events must update the selector to specify the Kafka resource instead.
